name: Water Level
definition: The height of water in the tank, measured in meters (m), or equivalently the volume divided by cross-sectional area.

name: Inflow Rate
definition: The volumetric flow rate of water entering the tank through the inlet, measured in cubic meters per second (m³/s).

name: Outflow Rate
definition: The volumetric flow rate of water leaving the tank through the outlet, measured in cubic meters per second (m³/s).

name: Net Flow Rate
definition: The difference between inflow and outflow rates, representing the rate of change of water volume in the tank.

name: Outlet Pressure
definition: The hydrostatic pressure at the outlet, proportional to water level: P = ρgh, where ρ is water density, g is gravity, h is water height.

name: Outlet Valve Opening
definition: The degree to which the outlet valve is open, from 0 (closed) to 1 (fully open), controlling flow resistance.
